title: Regulations for Tier B Street Frontages
previewText:
The provisions of this Section, inclusive, shall apply to the ground floor level street frontage of a building along a Tier B street frontage. Such provisions include ground floor level:

use and transparency requirements, as set forth in Section 32-321; alternative regulations, for certain block frontages, as set forth in Section 32-322; and curb cut restrictions for all frontages, as set forth in Section 32-323.
